openingDoorDialogue.bodyText: This moon appears to have been abandoned. You are likely to find no signs of life, so it will be an easy job.
Your mission: to collect scrap worth monetary value.
As specified on your contract, you will recieve 20% of the earnings accrued by H.E. Global. As also specified, we are not responsible for injuries taken while on the job.

gameOverDialogue.bodyText: Warning! No response from crew, which has not returned. Emergency code activated.
The autopilot will now attempt to fly to the closest safe spaceport. Your items have been lost.

shipLeavingOnMidnightDialogue.bodyText: Alert! The autopilot is leaving due to dangerous conditions.
The Company must minimize risk of damage to proprietary hardware. Goodbye!

shipLeavingSoonDialogue.bodyText: WARNING!!! The autopilot ship will leave at midnight. Please return quickly.

shipLeavingEarlyDialogue.bodyText: WARNING!!! Please return by [timeToLeave]. A vote has been cast, and the autopilot ship will leave early.
